supersedes: program-v1. v1's three cycles ran with a read/edit-only policy agent, a static grid and the memory rule that cycle 3 exploited. v2 starts from the baseline policy with no history, under the rules below. v1 nodes, scores and policies are not pooled with v2 and are not used as v2's starting point.

statistics.multiplicity: pre-register primary comparisons; report all others as exploratory

starting_policy.note: The loop copies this default OptimalPolicy to policies/v000_initial/policy.py. The search starts with no trees, no beta sweeps and no scores: cycles/ and policies/ hold only what this run writes.

run_budget.note: Pre-registered launch budget. It matches the launch command in studies/program-v2/README.md; a run that changes it records the change in revisions.

starting_rules.rule: The policy-development agent gets read,write,edit,bash; repo source read-only at /tmp/repo without rsi/synth.py, GPU visible, network, writable /tmp/pkgs on PYTHONPATH, and a runnable replay.py in the workspace. It may run and measure its own replay before answering. The harness still audits, replays and selects; the agent's own numbers are never used.
1200 s per policy-development step, one repair attempt also after a not-better step.

Anytime. The prompt asks for a valid method.py early and in-place improvement after that. On timeout the harness audits and replays the file as it stands and records timeout_salvaged; it is accepted only if it passes the audit and strictly beats the incumbent. A missing or unusable file leaves status timeout. Cost and transcript are kept.

Live. The selected policy's plan_grid decides the next cycle's grid from the last three manifests and beta sweeps; the protocol grid values (max_parallelism, rounds_cap) and the run arguments (probe budget, GPU slots) are caps, and the protocol grid is the pre-registered fallback. A candidate whose plan_grid fails validation is rejected.

Resident bytes are the largest of the tensor walk of the returned policy and workspace modules, every tensor/array/buffer payload the solution kept alive anywhere in the process, live CUDA bytes, and peak CUDA bytes during the episodes; measured after compress and again after inference. Workspace files over 1 MiB count in full. The discovery prompt states that hiding or deferring memory fails the node.

grid_plan.rationale: Pre-registered fallback grid and the caps on the policy's plan_grid. The live plan_grid chooses the applied grid within these caps.

dream_rsi.policy: paper-faithful replay policy; generated policy code must be recorded by hash
